notes.title: Team Update: Members can be promoted, and points can be assigned
notes.content: Team Leaders can now promote/demote team members. They can also assign/remove Team points.

notes.content:
New: Player Level-up sequence
Fixes: various UI fixes an improvements when spectating or playing in a 2v2 Match
Fix: AI will now play in the bottom row of the board
Prep: Adam Koralic
Prep: Steam Achievements
Lower: Chat costs
UI: Show Game Mode in pre-match screen
Perf: reduce "hitches" in gameplay from server events
Balance: Prefer AI closer in level to Players
